title: The promotion sequence
description: Shared infrastructure should be the result of repeated evidence, not a guess made before the second consumer exists.

nodes.title: Specific solution
nodes.detail: Solve the first real problem directly.

nodes.title: Repeated consumers
nodes.detail: The same shape appears in more than one place.

nodes.title: Stable semantic contract
nodes.detail: Separate the meaning that callers share from implementation details.

nodes.title: Shared implementation
nodes.detail: Move the proven mechanism behind the contract.

nodes.title: Narrower callers
nodes.detail: Consumers depend on the useful boundary, not the machinery.
